Great beer, great price, great location!
Jul 2020 • Friends
Amazing location for craft beer! A rooftop on Pasteur Street!!!

Great and vast selection of brews, and super pricing. I liked the mango New England IPA a lot.

Grabbed some food, the pork dumplings are really good. Not the same as the Chinese ones, but super tasty and good to fill you up when you are having a long session.

A great experience, and Sergey owner is a great guy to talk to!
